mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we are seeing overcast skies near the Verona Area High School, and the moon is in its third quarter phase. Expect the temperature to dip to an overnight low of 66 degrees, with rain predicted to move in as well.

The City of Verona has some great updates. The Senior Center is currently running a tri-shaw bike program that offers free, scenic rides on the Military Ridge State Trail for community members. Additionally, if you are looking to help with city beautification, the city is providing a rain barrel rebate program to help residents reduce stormwater runoff.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can catch trivia at either Hop Haus Brewing Co. or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, we have a busy day with trivia at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, and much more.
Regarding local safety, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a driver being arrested for O W I after they were observed driving on a flat tire without active taillights.
Make sure to satisfy your sweet tooth with today's flavor, Butter Pecan. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by and grab a scoop.
